findings.description: The `self.initial` attribute is no longer assigned, so code that reads `wait_exponential_jitter(...).initial` now raises AttributeError, even though `initial` is only deprecated.
findings.rationale: Trigger: user code reads the `.initial` attribute of an existing wait_exponential_jitter instance. Mechanism: the diff removes `self.initial = initial` and sets only `self.multiplier`. Impact: a deprecated-but-supported parameter breaks any reader of that attribute with an AttributeError, which a deprecation should not do.
